methods.name: Cell-gate dyadic rotation refinement / target-free Viete checker
capabilities: certify 2*u_(m+1)=iota_m(u_m) for the three-step root state
locate the first quarter-turn in the actual Cell-gate C12 layer
show reflection exchanges the two quarter-turn roots
classify Cell, gate, and higher-transition birth levels
compute target-free nested-radical traces and Viete products
produce monotone rotation-pi approximants without importing classical pi
produce a target-free algebraic completion-tail bound
methods.core_law: For Gamma_m=Z/(6*2^m), iota_m(k)=2k and u_m=3, ord(u_m)=2^(m+1) and 2*u_(m+1)=iota_m(u_m). The compatible character traces satisfy c_(m+1)^2=(1+c_m)/2 and 2/prod_{j=2}^m c_j=2^m s_m.
methods.hard_boundary: The first C6-to-C12 refinement has an actual Cell/gate incidence realization. Levels beyond C12 are transition/history refinements unless separately physically realized. The checker does not identify carrier directions with P000 native axes, derive a global operation-safe rotation quotient, or prove the classical analytic identity pi_rot=pi. No Driver review or shared-tool promotion is requested by this addendum.
